description: This PHP file provides functions for handling and verifying JWT tokens, including signature verification, token data validation, and key management, used for authentication purposes.

methods.name: VerifyToken
methods.description: Verifies the validity of a JWT token by checking its structure, signature, and token data.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the JWT token's signature using the public key retrieved from the server.

methods.name: CheckModTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the modification time of a key file is within a valid time window.

methods.name: VerifyTokenData
methods.description: Validates token payload data, including time-based claims and tenant ID.

methods.name: WritePubKey
methods.description: Writes the retrieved public key in PEM format to a file.

methods.name: LogTokenData
methods.description: Logs token information and validation results to a log file.
